title: Same question, 36M rows scanned vs 60 rows read
caption: Pre-aggregation moves the counting from every query to ingest time, where it happens once.

messages.label: clicks for ad1, last hour?
messages.note: Without an index by ad, the query reads every click of the hour: 10k/s × 3,600 s = 36M rows.

messages.label: answer after seconds
messages.note: Too slow for a panel that refreshes every 10 s, and the cost repeats on every refresh by every viewer.

messages.label: GET ad1 @ 12:00 … 12:59
messages.note: The counting already happened as events arrived.

messages.label: 60 rows, ~2 ms
messages.note: 60 small rows. The work no longer depends on how many clicks there were.
